expected_effect: Public val_bpb decreases by 0.0010 to 0.0030 relative to the same-host control (target <= 1.0047 on trn21, <= 1.0050 on trn22), driven by a step-count increase of +1.5% to +5% (>= 2102 steps on trn21, >= 2107 on trn22) with an unchanged per-step loss trajectory. If steps land within +/-1% of control the flag is classified inert at this commit and the hypothesis is falsified regardless of BPB.
hypothesis: Both pinned 9a4caa7b controls run with qk_shift=True qk_beta=0.0 qk_freeze=True (ledger oneliners for al-20260922-control-trn21/trn22-lnc2x4-9a4caa7b-full-r1). A token-shift branch whose mixing coefficient is frozen at exactly zero contributes no learnable signal and leaves the forward function identical to a model without the branch, but the shifted-copy/scale/add ops on q and k in every layer (plus their backward) still execute each step because the zero lives in a runtime tensor the compiler cannot constant-fold. Passing --no-qk-shift therefore removes dead compute only: per-step loss trajectory is unchanged while step rate rises, so the fixed 1800 s budget yields more optimizer steps and a lower public val_bpb. Every fresh-start lineage run from fs-w6 onward (fs-w6 description: 'no frozen-zero QK shift') through the frozen candidate submissions/dense6x1024_public0992851/train.py already passes --no-qk-shift, but no paired same-commit measurement of the branch's cost exists; this run supplies that isolated measurement at the default full-chip shape.
single_causal_change: Pass --no-qk-shift only. Every other option stays at the 9a4caa7b defaults used by the two pinned controls: identical launch shape (NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2, torchrun --nproc_per_node=4, --num-steps 5000, --max-train-seconds 1800, --seed 42), identical environment (NEURON_CC_FLAGS exactly '--optlevel=1', NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_SEED=42, PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1), no precision, kernel, optimizer, schedule, batch, architecture, or evaluation change. --qk-shift-freeze and any qk beta option are not passed. The only behavioral delta is removal of the frozen-zero QK token-shift branch (qk_shift False in the run's resolved oneliners). Matched comparison: the same-host pinned control (trn21 -> 2071 steps / 1.005734; trn22 -> 2076 steps / 1.005967), compared on public_val_bpb (the controller's shared scorer on public data; the private-shard score is not accessible and is not claimed). Outcome classes are mutually exclusive and evaluated in order: (1) FALSIFIED-INERT if candidate steps are within +/-1% of the same-host control steps (branch already eliminated or negligible); (2) CONFOUNDED if steps differ by more than +10% (protocol section 5 quality rule; record as a throughput result only); (3) SUCCESS if steps are >= +1.5% and public_val_bpb is lower than the same-host control; (4) FALSIFIED-QUALITY if steps are >= +1% but public_val_bpb is not lower (branch was not inert, or extra steps do not translate); (5) INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (step gain between 1% and 1.5%).
